title: Card arm model template
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Muscles and bones (7C); the particle model (7G)
source: Written for science/y7 lesson 24 (Card arm model template (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 24. Make a model arm to show how the biceps and triceps work as an antagonistic pair.

labels: Lower arm (radius and ulna): cut out

practical.aim: Show that muscles can only pull, so they work in pairs.
equipment: Two pieces of string (biceps and triceps)
Sticky tape and scissors (an adult helps)
safety: An adult makes the hole for the split pin
method: Cut out the two arm pieces.
An adult makes a hole near the end of each piece; join them with the split pin to make the elbow joint.
Tape one string to the top of the lower arm and run it up the front of the upper arm: the biceps.
Tape the other string behind the elbow and run it up the back: the triceps.
Pull the biceps string: the arm bends. Pull the triceps string: it straightens.
Label the joint, the two muscles and the bones.

questions.q: Why do muscles work in pairs?
questions.a: Muscles can only pull (contract), not push, so one muscle bends the joint and the other straightens it (an antagonistic pair).
